definitions.gloss: everyday use; regular use; habitual use
definitions.explanation: Using something routinely, as a normal part of daily life or work. Said of words and characters, tools, and medicines; with drugs it can mean habitual use.

examples.japanese: {常用|じょうよう}{漢字|かんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{常用|じょうよう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather takes blood pressure medicine regularly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{睡眠薬|すいみんやく}→睡眠薬：28681_suiminyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{常用|じょうよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなく→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you take sleeping pills habitually, you may become unable to sleep without them.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常用|じょうよう}{漢字|かんじ}: the jōyō kanji, the official list of 2,136 characters for general use
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{常用|じょうよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take a medicine regularly
- {常用者|じょうようしゃ}: a regular user (often of drugs)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The ⟦{常用漢字|じょうようかんじ}→常用漢字：20778_jouyoukanji⟧ list is the government's guide to the characters used in newspapers, official documents, and school teaching. Words whose kanji fall outside it are often written partly or wholly in kana.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{愛用|あいよう}→愛用：12693_aiyou⟧: using something regularly because one likes it
